title: ASCII Code to Character

content.problemStatement:
**Print ASCII Value**
Write a program to accept a Integer as input from the user and print its corresponding Character value.

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input '65' produces expected output '' following problem rules.
Input '122' produces expected output '' following problem rules.

solution.approach: Convert an integer ASCII code to its character representation.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Cast the input integer to a char (e.g. 65 -> 'A').

hints: Every character has an underlying integer ASCII code.
In C/Java/C++, cast the integer to (char).
In Python, use chr(val). In JS, use String.fromCharCode(val).
learningObjectives: Perform type casting between integers and characters.
Work with character representation across languages.
